desc: Ideate reduction to maximizing kept vertices and per-center capacities.

Implement complete Python solution using direct per-center sorting: read input, build adjacency and degrees, for each vertex collect positive capacities deg(neighbor)-1, sort descending, evaluate 1 + k*(capacity+1), track max kept, and print N - max_kept.
Verify edge cases: paths, stars, all vertices as centers, x/y positive, minimum 3-vertex snowflake.
